statement: Alcohol reduces alertness, interferes with judgment, and impairs vision.

statement: Coffee, fresh air, cold showers and exercise do not sober anyone up — time is the only sobering influence.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)

label: One drink equals one drink
statement: A one-ounce shot of 100-proof whiskey, a six-ounce glass of wine and a 12-ounce can of beer all contain the same amount of alcohol.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)

label: BAC keeps rising after the last drink
statement: When a person has more than one drink per hour, BAC builds up and keeps rising for hours after the last drink.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Driving Impaired or Under the Influence
source.sourceQuote: When a person has more than one (1) drink per hour, the BAC level builds up in his or her body.

label: Legal drinking age
statement: The legal drinking age in West Virginia is 21.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Driving Impaired or Under the Influence
source.sourceQuote: The legal drinking age in West Virginia is 21 years old.

label: Zero tolerance under 21
statement: If you are under 21 and any measurable amount of alcohol is found in your system, you will lose your driver's license.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Driving Impaired or Under the Influence
source.sourceQuote: This means that if you are under the age of 21 and any amount of alcohol is found in your system, you

label: BAC 0.08 presumption
statement: A BAC of 0.08 percent or more means the driver is presumed to be driving under the influence.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Driving Impaired or Under the Influence
source.sourceQuote: If a driver's BAC is 0.08 percent

label: BAC between 0.05 and 0.08
statement: A BAC above 0.05 but below 0.08 percent is relevant evidence to presume the driver's ability to drive is impaired, and a licence can be revoked below 0.08.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Driving Impaired or Under the Influence

label: Implied consent
statement: By driving, you are deemed to have consented to a Breathalyzer if arrested for DUI; refusing revokes your driving privilege for one year up to life.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Driving Impaired or Under the Influence
source.section: Implied Consent and the Chemical Test
source.sourceQuote: If you refuse to take the Breathalyzer, your privilege to operate a motor vehicle will be revoked

label: Safety and Treatment Program
statement: Any time a licence is revoked or suspended for DUI, you must complete a prescribed Safety and Treatment program before you can be reinstated.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Driving Impaired or Under the Influence
source.section: Penalties for Driving Under the Influence
source.sourceQuote: Any time your driver's license is revoked or suspended for a DUI, you must complete a prescribed Safety

label: Ignition interlock
statement: The Interlock device attaches to the ignition and prevents an intoxicated person from starting the car; participation is mandatory for two or more DUI revocations within ten years.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Driving Impaired or Under the Influence
source.section: How Does a DUI Affect Your Driving Privileges?
source.sourceQuote: If the driver has been revoked for two (2) or more DUI's or related offenses

label: Prescription and OTC drugs
statement: Drugs can cause drowsiness, loss of coordination, hallucinations or total body malfunction even when prescribed by a physician or bought over the counter.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)

source.sourceQuote: even if prescribed by a physician or bought over the counter, can cause drowsiness, loss of coordination,

label: Drowsy driving is impaired driving
statement: After being awake for about 18 hours, driving skills are comparable to someone under the influence of drugs or alcohol.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Driving Impaired or Under the Influence
source.sourceQuote: After being awake for 18 hours (time

label: Checking the brake pedal
statement: The brake pedal should not go more than halfway to the floor and should feel like it is hitting something hard; a spongy pedal may mean air in the brake line.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: It should not go more than halfway to the floor.

label: The penny tread test
statement: Put a penny into the deepest groove with Lincoln's head first — if you can see all of his head, the tires are too worn to drive on.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Can you see all of his head?  If yes, your tires

label: Checking tire pressure
statement: Check tire pressure monthly with a gauge while the tires are cold, comparing against the PSI figure on the sticker inside the driver's door jamb.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Check tire pressure with a gauge monthly

label: Surviving a blowout
statement: In a blowout, hold the wheel tightly, steer straight ahead and ease off the accelerator — do not brake until the vehicle is under control.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: hold tightly to the steering wheel, steer straight ahead, and ease up on the accelerator.

label: What causes blowouts
statement: Under-inflated tires are one of the most common causes of blowouts.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Under-inflated tires are one of the most common causes of blowouts

label: If the brakes fail
statement: Pump the brake pedal quickly, shift to a lower gear, warn others with horn and lights, and use the parking brake while holding the release.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Shift to a lower gear and look for a place to slow down and stop off the roadway.

label: Steering out of a skid
statement: In a skid, take your foot off the gas and turn the steering wheel in the direction of the skid; do not brake unless you are in danger of hitting something.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Turn your steering wheel in the direction of the skid.

label: Overheating engine
statement: If the engine overheats, pull off the road and turn it off — do not remove the radiator cap until the engine has cooled.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Do not remove the radiator cap until the engine has cooled off.

label: Stuck gas pedal
statement: If the gas pedal sticks, keep steering and watching the road, try to free it with your foot, then push in the clutch or shift to neutral before braking to a safe stop.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: If this does not work, push in the clutch or shift into neutral.

label: Wheels off the pavement
statement: If your wheels drop off the road, grip the wheel, stay on the shoulder, ease off the accelerator and slow gradually before turning back onto the pavement.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Stay on the shoulder and ease off the accelerator.

label: Vehicle fire
statement: Smother a vehicle fire with dirt or sand, never water, because burning gasoline floats on water and spreads the fire; if it gets out of control move at least 100 feet away.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Do not use water because burning gasoline will float on water and spread the fire.

label: Headlight failure
statement: If your headlights fail on a dark highway, try parking lights, turn signals or emergency flashers and get off the roadway; if all lights fail, stay on the roadway and slow down enough to pull off safely.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: If all lights fail, stay on the roadway and slow down enough

label: Stop and secure the scene
statement: If you are involved in a crash, stop immediately, turn off the ignition to prevent fire, and protect the scene to prevent further crashes.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.section: If You are Involved In A Crash
source.sourceQuote: Turn off the ignition to prevent the danger of fire.

label: Reporting a crash
statement: A crash causing injury or death, or property damage of $1,000 or more, must be reported to the nearest law enforcement agency.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.section: If You are Involved In A Crash
source.sourceQuote: you must notify the nearest law enforcement agency.

label: Information to exchange
statement: Drivers involved in a crash should exchange name, address, license plate number and motor vehicle insurance information.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.section: If You are Involved In A Crash
source.sourceQuote: The following information should be exchanged by persons involved in traffic crashes

label: Striking an unattended vehicle
statement: If you strike an unattended vehicle, try to find the owner; if you cannot, leave a written notice with your name, address, plate number, insurance information and the circumstances.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: If you strike an unattended vehicle, try to locate

label: Do not stop at other crashes
statement: Do not stop at a crash scene unless you are involved or can render assistance — unnecessary stopping creates additional hazards.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Do not stop at a crash scene unless you are

label: First aid priority order
statement: Give first aid in this order: control bleeding, restore breathing, treat for shock, protect broken bones — and do not move the victim unless there is danger of further injury.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Stay calm and do not move the victim unless there is danger of further injury.

label: Good Samaritan law
statement: Anyone who in good faith gives emergency care at a crash scene without pay is not liable for civil damages for any act or omission in giving that care.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: care at the scene of a crash, without pay, is liable for any civil damages

label: A licence is required to drive on public roads
statement: If you live in West Virginia and want to drive on public roads you must hold a West Virginia driver's license unless you are expressly exempt.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.section: Who Must Be Licensed to Drive?
source.sourceQuote: If you live in West Virginia and want to drive a motor vehicle on public roads, you must have a West Virginia driver's license, unless you are expressly exempt.

label: Carry your licence and produce it on demand
statement: You must carry your licence or permit when you drive and produce it on demand to any law enforcement officer, magistrate or DMV official; failing to do so is a misdemeanor.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: You are required to provide your driver's license or instruction permit upon demand to any law enforcement officer, magistrate, or official of the DMV. Violation of this requirement is a misdemeanor.

label: Nonresident exemption is limited to 90 days
statement: A nonresident at least 16 years old with a valid licence from another state or country is exempt, but only for 90 days in a calendar year.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: A nonresident who is at least 16 years old and has a valid license from another state or country (limited to 90 days in a calendar year)

label: Under 18 and not in school can be denied
statement: Anyone under 18 who is not enrolled in, or graduated from, an approved educational institution can be denied a driver's license.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.section: Who Can Be Denied a Driver's License?
source.sourceQuote: Any person who is under the age of 18  and  not enrolled  in, or graduated from, an approved educational institution

label: Two card types: Not For Federal Use, or REAL ID
statement: You choose between a Not For Federal Use card and a REAL ID/For Federal Use card, which carries a gold star and meets federal requirements for airports and federal facilities.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.section: There Are TWO types Driver's Licenses & ID Cards
source.sourceQuote: You have the choice between a Not For Federal Use driver's license or ID card, or a REAL ID/For Federal Use card that contains a gold star, indicating that the card meets full federal requirements for future use at airports and other designated federal facilities and uses nationwide.

label: REAL ID costs an extra $10.00
statement: The For Federal Use (REAL ID) card costs an additional $10.00 and arrives by USPS in 15-20 business days.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.section: There Are TWO types Driver's Licenses & ID Cards
source.sourceQuote: This card costs an additional $10.00 and is sent to the applicant's address via USPS in 15-20 business days.

label: What a first-time applicant must bring
statement: A first-time applicant for a permit, licence or ID card must provide a Social Security number, one proof of identity, two proofs of WV residency and the DMV-DS-23P form.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Any first-time applicant for an instruction permit, driver's license, or identification card must provide their Social Security number, one (1) proof of identity document, two (2) proofs of WV residency documents, and the DMV-DS-23P provided by DMV.

label: Hospital birth certificates are not accepted
statement: U.S. Department of State and U.S. Military birth certificates are acceptable proof of identity, but hospital birth certificates and Bureau of Census records are not.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.section: Proof Documents Required to Obtain a Driver's License
source.sourceQuote: U.S. Department of State and U.S. Military birth certificates ARE acceptable, hospital birth certificates and Bureau of Census records are NOT acceptable

label: Two proofs of West Virginia residency
statement: You must provide two separate documents proving West Virginia residency.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.section: Proof Documents Required to Obtain a Driver's License
source.sourceQuote: You must have TWO (2) proofs of West Virginia residency.

label: No PO Box, and nothing over 90 days old
statement: A residency document showing a PO Box is not accepted, and a recurring document such as a utility bill cannot be more than 90 days old.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.section: Proof Documents Required to Obtain a Driver's License
source.sourceQuote: Documents with a PO Box are not acceptable.  Any recurring document cannot be more than 90 days old (i.e. utility bill).

label: Vision and knowledge tests earn the Class E permit
statement: Once your application and documents are accepted you take the vision and knowledge tests, and passing both gets you a regular Class E instruction permit.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.section: Regular Instruction Permit - Ages 18 and Over
source.sourceQuote: When you have completed the application and presented the appropriate documents, you will be allowed to take the vision and knowledge tests.  When you pass the vision and knowledge tests, you will be issued a regular Class E instruction permit.

label: The permit lasts six months; if it expires you retest
statement: A regular instruction permit is valid for six months, and if it expires you must retake both the vision and knowledge tests to get another one.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.section: Regular Instruction Permit - Ages 18 and Over
source.sourceQuote: permit will be valid for a period of six (6) months.  If expired, YOU MUST RETEST, taking both the vision and knowledge tests to obtain another instruction permit.

label: Hold the permit 30 days before the road test
statement: If you have never held a Level 2 graduated licence or comparable, you must hold the instruction permit at least 30 days before you are eligible to take the road skills test.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.section: Regular Instruction Permit - Ages 18 and Over
source.sourceQuote: If you have never been licensed as Level 2 graduated driver's license or comparable, you must maintain the instruction permit for at least 30 days before you are eligible to take the road skills test.

label: No electronic devices, and no one else, in the exam room
statement: Cell phones, PDAs, Bluetooth and other electronic devices are not permitted in the exam room, and only the applicant taking the test may be in it.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.section: Regular Instruction Permit - Ages 18 and Over
source.sourceQuote: No cell phones, PDA, Bluetooth devices, electronic devices, etc. will be permitted in the exam room.  Only the applicant taking the test is allowed in the exam room.

label: Level 1 minimum age is 15
statement: You must be at least 15 years of age to hold a Level 1 GDL instruction permit.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: You must be at least 15 years of age.

label: Written parental consent on form DMV-DS-23P
statement: A Level 1 GDL instruction permit requires written consent from a parent or legal guardian on form DMV-DS-23P.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: You must have written consent from a Parent or Legal Guardian on form DMV-DS-23P.

label: A licensed driver 21+ in the right front seat
statement: On a Level 1 GDL instruction permit you may only drive with a licensed driver at least 21 years old in the right front passenger seat.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: You may only drive with a licensed driver who is at least 21 years old in the right front passenger seat.

label: Level 1 driving hours: 5:00 am to 10:00 pm
statement: A Level 1 GDL instruction permit holder may only drive between 5:00 am and 10:00 pm.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: You may only drive between the hours of 5:00 am and 10:00 pm.

label: Two non-family passengers on top of the supervisor
statement: On a Level 1 permit you may carry only two additional non-family passengers in addition to the supervising licensed adult driver.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: You may only have two (2) additional non family passengers in addition to the supervising, licensed adult driver.

label: Zero tolerance: no measurable alcohol
statement: Under zero tolerance you may not have any measurable amount of alcohol in your system while operating a motor vehicle.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: ZERO Tolerance: You may not have any measurable amount of alcohol in your system while operating a motor vehicle.

label: You must require all occupants to belt up
statement: A Level 1 permit holder must require all occupants of the vehicle to adhere to the safety belt law.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: You must require all occupants to adhere to the safety belt law.

label: No wireless device except to call 9-1-1
statement: A Level 1 permit holder may not use a wireless communication device while driving unless the use is for contacting a 9-1-1 system.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: You may not use a wireless communication device while operating a motor vehicle, unless the use of the wireless communication device is for contacting a 9-1-1 system

label: Level 1 expires on the 18th birthday
statement: A Level 1 GDL instruction permit is issued up to the applicant's 18th birthday and expires on that birthday, with a 30-day grace period to complete the road skills examination.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: A Level 1 GDL instruction permit will be issued up to the applicant's 18th birthday, and will expire on the 18th birthday.

label: Level 2 is for ages 16 to 18 who finished Level 1
statement: If you are between 16 and 18 and have completed all the Level 1 GDL requirements, you are eligible for a Level 2 GDL intermediate driver's license.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: If you are between the ages of 16 and 18 and have completed all the requirements of the Level 1 GDL instruction permit, you will be eligible for a Level 2 GDL intermediate driver's license.

label: 180 consecutive conviction-free days at Level 1
statement: Level 2 requires a minimum of 180 consecutive days of conviction-free driving at Level 1 immediately before the Level 2 application.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Have a minimum of 180 consecutive days of conviction-free driving at Level 1 GDL immediately preceding the date of your Level 2 application

label: 50 hours behind the wheel, 10 of them at night
statement: Level 2 requires a parent or guardian certified log sheet of at least 50 hours behind the wheel including at least 10 hours at night, or completion of an approved driver's education course.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Have a parent or legal guardian certification (log sheet) of  a minimum  of 50 hours behind the wheel, including the  minimum of 10 hours at night or complete a driver's education course approved by the West Virginia Department of Education

label: 10:00 pm to 5:00 am needs a supervising adult
statement: A Level 2 holder must drive with a supervising licensed adult driver aged 21 or older between 10:00 pm and 5:00 am.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Level 2 GDL intermediate driver's license must drive with a supervising, licensed adult driver who is age 21 or older between the hours of 10:00 pm and 5:00 am.

label: Four exceptions to the night-driving rule
statement: The night supervision rule does not apply when the licensee is going to, taking part in, or returning from lawful employment, a school-sanctioned activity, a religious activity, or an emergency to prevent injury or death.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: The exceptions to this rule are when the licensee is participating in, going to, or returning from: (1) lawful employment; (2) a school-sanctioned activity; (3) a religious activity; or (4) an emergency situation that requires the licensee to prevent bodily injury or the death of another.

label: First six months: no non-family passengers under 20
statement: For the first six months at Level 2 you may not carry any non-family member under the age of 20 as a passenger.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: A Level 2 GDL intermediate driver's license holder may not operate a motor vehicle during their first six months with any non-family members under the age of 20 as a passenger

label: Second six months: only one passenger under 20
statement: During the second six months at Level 2 you may carry no more than one non-family member under the age of 20 as a passenger.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: may not operate a motor vehicle with more than one (1) non-family member under the age of 20 as a passenger during the second six (6) months.

label: Level 2 keeps zero alcohol and the belt duty
statement: A Level 2 holder may not drive with any measurable alcohol in their system and must require all occupants to follow the seat belt law.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Level 2 GDL intermediate driver's license may not operate a motor vehicle with any measurable alcohol in their system and must require all occupants to follow the seat belt law.

label: Surrendering Level 2 under 18 sends you back to Level 1
statement: If you surrender a Level 2 intermediate licence for any reason while under 18, you must start over with a Level 1 GDL instruction permit.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: If you surrender your Level 2 GDL intermediate driver's license for any reason and are under the age of 18, you must start over with a Level 1 GDL instruction permit.

label: Level 1: six conviction-free months, restarted by each conviction
statement: You must be conviction-free for six months to move up to Level 2, and each conviction restarts the six-month window from the conviction date.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.section: Levels 1 and 2 GDL Violations and Convictions
source.sourceQuote: You must be conviction-free for 6 months in order to graduate to a Level 2 Intermediate driver's license.  With each conviction the 6-month window starts over from the date of the conviction.

label: Two convictions at Level 1 revokes the permit for 90 days
statement: Two convictions on a Level 1 GDL instruction permit revoke it for 90 days, after which you must re-apply and retest for the Level 1 permit.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.section: Levels 1 and 2 GDL Violations and Convictions
source.sourceQuote: Under a Level 1 GDL instruction permit, two (2) convictions will result in the revocation of your GDL for 90 days. When 90 days are up you will be required to re-apply and retest for your Level 1 GDL instruction permit.

label: Level 2: twelve conviction-free months before Level 3
statement: You must be conviction-free for 12 months before graduating to Level 3, and a conviction restarts the 12-month period from that point.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.section: Levels 1 and 2 GDL Violations and Convictions
source.sourceQuote: You are required to be conviction-free for 12 months prior to graduating to a  Level 3 GDL.  If you receive a conviction, the 12-month conviction-free period will start over again at the point of  that conviction.

label: A second moving violation at Level 2 costs the licence until 18
statement: A second conviction for a moving violation at Level 2 revokes your driving privilege until you are 18, and you must then retest as a first-time applicant.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.section: Levels 1 and 2 GDL Violations and Convictions
source.sourceQuote: The second conviction for a moving violation requires the revocation of your driving privilege until you are 18 and you will be required to retest as a first-time applicant.

label: A phone citation restarts the conviction-free clock
statement: A citation for using a cell phone or wireless device on a Level 1 or Level 2 GDL makes you begin the conviction-free time period over again.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.section: Levels 1 and 2 GDL Violations and Convictions
source.sourceQuote: If a citation is issued for the use of a cell phone or wireless communication device on a Level 1 GDL instruction permit or Level 2 GDL intermediate driver's license, you must begin the conviction-free time period over

label: Level 3 needs 12 conviction-free months and age 17
statement: To be eligible for a Level 3 GDL you must have completed 12 months of conviction-free driving at Level 2, be at least 17 years old, and have completed all requirements.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: To be eligible for a Level 3 GDL, you must have completed 12 months of conviction-free driving under a Level 2 GDL, be at least 17 years old, and have successfully completed all requirements.

label: Vertical cards: red under 18, blue 18 to 20
statement: Applicants 15 to 17 get a vertical card colour-coded red, and applicants 18 to 20 get a vertical card colour-coded blue.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Applicants 15 to 17 years old are issued a driver's license or instruction permit that is vertical and color-coded red.  Applicants 18 to 20 years old, are issued a vertical driver's license or instruction permit that is color-coded blue.

label: Restriction codes on the front, explained on the back
statement: A restriction appears as a number or letter code in the restrictions field on the front of the licence, and is explained on the back of the card.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: The restriction will be indicated on the front of the driver's license by a number or letter code in the “restrictions” field.  The explanation of the restriction will appear on the back of the driver's license.

label: Drive for Five expiration
statement: Under Drive for Five, licences expire in a year in which your age is divisible by five, and the licence is valid for five years once you are in the cycle.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Under the “Drive for Five” program, all driver's  licenses will expire in a year in which your age is divisible by five (for example, age 25, 30, 35, 40, 45, etc.).

label: Report an address change within 20 days, in writing
statement: You must notify the DMV in writing within 20 days of an address change, and failing to do so subjects you to a possible fine or imprisonment.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: If you change your address you are required to notify, in writing, the DMV within 20 days of the change. Failure to do this subjects you to a possible fine or imprisonment.

label: New residents have 30 days to apply
statement: After establishing West Virginia residency, a new resident who wants to drive must apply for a WV driver's license within 30 days.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: After establishing WV residency, new residents who want to drive in WV must apply for a WV driver's license within 30 days.

label: Transferring a valid out-of-state licence
statement: To transfer a valid out-of-state licence you must pass a vision screening, complete a brief alcohol awareness course, and surrender the out-of-state licence.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: You are required to pass a vision screening, complete a brief alcohol awareness course, and surrender your out-of-state driver's license before a WV driver's license will be issued.

label: Expired three years or more means retesting
statement: Anyone renewing a WV licence, including a CDL, that has been expired for three years or more is required to retest.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Any person renewing a WV driver's license, including a CDL, that has been expired for three (3) years or more is required to retest.

label: Driving is a privilege carrying responsibilities
statement: The privilege to drive carries many responsibilities, and you alone are responsible for your actions behind the wheel.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: The privilege to drive carries with it many responsibilities.  You, and only you, are responsible for your actions.

label: School non-attendance restricts a minor's licence
statement: If your school notifies the DMV that you are not attending or have excessive unexcused absences, your licence is further restricted until age 18 or until you present a school reinstatement authorization and pay the fee.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: If your school notifies the DMV that you are not attending or have excessive unexcused absences

label: The Commissioner can order a re-examination
statement: You may be required to take a medical, written or driving examination if the Commissioner of Motor Vehicles has good cause to believe you are incompetent or otherwise not qualified to be licensed.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: You may be required to take a medical, written, or driving examination if the Commissioner of Motor Vehicles has good cause to believe you are incompetent or otherwise not qualified to be licensed.

label: Crash reporting: over $1,000 or any injury, within five days
statement: A crash causing injury or death, or property damage over $1,000, must be reported by the quickest means possible within five days to the local police if it happened in a municipality, otherwise to the county sheriff or nearest WV State Police office.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Crashes resulting in injury to, or death of, any person or property damage in excess of $1,000 must be reported by the quickest means possible (oral or written) within five (5) days to the local police department if it occurs within a municipality

label: No insurance at the time of a crash costs you plate and licence
statement: If your vehicle was not covered by the required WV liability insurance on the date of a crash, your registration and driving privilege will be suspended.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: If your vehicle was not covered by the required West Virginia liability insurance on the date of the crash, your motor vehicle registration and driving privilege will be suspended.

label: Liability insurance is mandatory
statement: West Virginia law requires every motorist driving on public roads to carry West Virginia motor vehicle liability insurance.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: West Virginia law mandates that all motorists driving on the state's public roads must carry West Virginia motor vehicle liability insurance.

label: Minimum coverage amounts
statement: The minimum coverage provided by law is $25,000 for one death or injury, $50,000 for two deaths or injuries, and $25,000 for property damage.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: $25,000 for one (1) death or injury | $50,000 for two (2) deaths or injuries | $25,000 for property damage

label: Carry proof of insurance and the registration card
statement: A certificate of insurance or other proof of WV liability insurance must be carried in the vehicle at all times along with a valid vehicle registration card.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: a certificate of insurance or other proof of West Virginia liability insurance, which can be obtained from your insurance company, must be carried in your vehicle at all times, along with a valid vehicle registration card

label: No proof of insurance suspends licence and registration
statement: Failing to provide proof of WV liability insurance suspends both your driver's license and your vehicle registration, with reinstatement and penalty fees.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Failure to provide proof of West Virginia liability insurance will result in the suspension of your driver's license as well as your vehicle registration along with reinstatement and/or penalty fees.

label: False insurance information: 90 days, $1,000, up to a year
statement: Filing false or fraudulent insurance information brings an additional 90-day licence suspension, revocation of the vehicle registration, and possible prosecution carrying a fine of up to $1,000 and up to one year in jail.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Filing of false or fraudulent insurance information will result in an additional 90-day suspension of your driver's license, revocation of your vehicle registration, and possible prosecution that carries a fine of not more than $1,000 and jail time not to exceed one (1) year.

label: Electronic devices only if hands-free
statement: Using any electronic communications device while driving on a public street or highway is prohibited unless the use is accomplished by hands-free equipment.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.section: The Use of Communication Devices While Operating a Motor Vehicle
source.sourceQuote: The use of any electronic communications device while driving a motor vehicle on a public street or highway is prohibited unless the use is accomplished by hands-free equipment.

label: What hands-free actually means
statement: A hands-free device has a feature or function that lets the user engage it without using either or both hands.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.section: The Use of Communication Devices While Operating a Motor Vehicle
source.sourceQuote: A hands-free electronic communication device has a feature or function that allows the user to engage it without the use of either or both hands.

label: What counts as a device violation
statement: The violation covers using a non-hands-free device to make a call, view or transmit images or data, play games, or compose, send, read, access or retrieve email, texts or other electronic data.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.section: The Use of Communication Devices While Operating a Motor Vehicle
source.sourceQuote: Violation of this law includes using an electronic communications device that is not enabled as hands-free to engage in a call, view or transmit images or data, play games, or compose, send, read, view, access, browse, transmit, save, or retrieve an e-mail, text message, or other electronic data.

label: First offense: $100 and no points
statement: A first hands-free violation carries a $100 fine and zero points.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.section: The Use of Communication Devices While Operating a Motor Vehicle
source.sourceQuote: First offense = $100 fine and zero (0) points

label: Third offense: $300 and three points
statement: A third or subsequent hands-free violation carries a $300 fine and three points.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.section: The Use of Communication Devices While Operating a Motor Vehicle
source.sourceQuote: Third and subsequent offenses = $300 and three (3) points

label: Reporting an emergency is not a violation
statement: Using a device to report a fire, traffic crash, serious road hazard or emergency to the appropriate authorities is not a violation of the hands-free law.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.section: The Use of Communication Devices While Operating a Motor Vehicle
source.sourceQuote: Use of an electronic communications device to report a fire, traffic crash, serious road hazard, or emergency to the appropriate authorities

label: Points stay on your record for two years
statement: Points remain on your driving record for two years from the conviction date.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Points remain on your driving record for two (2) years from the conviction date.

label: Six points brings a letter of caution
statement: At six points or more the DMV sends a letter of caution urging you to drive carefully and obey traffic laws.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: When you have six (6) points or more on your record, the DMV will send you a letter of caution, urging you to be careful while driving and obedient of traffic laws.

label: Twelve points makes the licence subject to suspension
statement: When you accumulate 12 points on your record your driver's license is subject to suspension.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: When you accumulate 12 points on your record, your driver's license is subject to suspension.

label: An eight-hour class removes three points, once a year
statement: Completing an approved eight-hour defensive driving class deducts three points, and you are only eligible for that reduction once every 12 months.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: You may have three (3) points deducted from your record by completing an approved eight (8) hour defensive driving class.  Motorists are only eligible for this point reduction once every 12 months.

label: The class must be approved, and taken after the points appear
statement: Taking a class without DMV approval, or before the points appear on your record, makes you ineligible for the point deduction.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: If you take a class without approval from the DMV or take the class prior to the points appearing on your record, you will not be eligible for the point deduction.

label: Point values track the seriousness of the violation
statement: Points are assigned to in-state and out-of-state moving violations according to how serious the violation is.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Points have been assigned to various in-state and out-of-state moving traffic violations depending on the seriousness of the violation.

label: Two moving violations as a graduated driver means revocation
statement: Two or more moving violation convictions as a graduated driver is on the list of convictions for which the DMV must revoke a driver's license.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Two (2) or more moving violation convictions as a graduated driver

label: Leaving the scene of an injury crash means revocation
statement: Leaving the scene of a crash that results in death or personal injury requires immediate revocation of the driver's license.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Leaving the scene of a crash that results in death or personal injury

label: Driving while suspended can cost another 90 days
statement: Driving while your licence is suspended or revoked for a non-DUI reason is a serious matter and may cause a 90-day suspension.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.section: Driving While a Driver's License Is Revoked or Suspended
source.sourceQuote: Driving while your driver's license is suspended or revoked (non-DUI related) is a serious matter and may cause a 90-day suspension.

label: Misusing a licence: 90-day suspension
statement: Using someone else's licence as your own, letting someone use yours, lending your identity documents, or displaying a fictitious licence all carry a 90-day suspension.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: It is also illegal to use someone else's license as your own, to permit someone else to use your driver's license, to permit someone to use your identity documents to obtain a license, or to use or display a fictitious license.  The penalty for these offenses is a 90-day suspension.

label: Ignoring a citation or court order suspends your licence
statement: The DMV will suspend your licence until you present proof of compliance with the court action and pay all penalty fees.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.section: Failure to Comply with In-State Citations
source.sourceQuote: The DMV will suspend your driver's license until you present proof of compliance with the court action and all penalty fees are paid.

label: Out-of-state violations follow you home
statement: Under the Driver License Compact, traffic violations received in other states become part of your West Virginia driving record and points may be assessed.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: West Virginia is a member of the Driver License Compact.  Traffic violations you receive in other states will become part of your West Virginia driving record and, if warranted, points will be assessed.

label: Everyone takes the vision screening
statement: All persons, whether new applicants or renewals, must pass the vision screening.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: All persons, whether new applicants or renewals, will have to pass the vision screening.

label: The 20/40 standard using both eyes
statement: You pass the vision screening with 20/40 or better using both eyes, with or without conventional corrective lenses, and no serious visual defect.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: If your vision is 20/40 or better using both eyes, either with or without conventional corrective lenses, and you show no serious visual defect, you will pass the vision screening.

label: Needing glasses puts a restriction on the licence
statement: If you need glasses or contact lenses to reach 20/40, your licence will carry a restriction code for corrective lenses.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: If you require glasses or contact lenses to have a vision level of 20/40 or better, your driver's license will show a restriction code for “corrective lenses.”

label: One eye can still pass at 20/40
statement: An applicant with only one eye may be passed if the vision level in that eye is 20/40 or better.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: If you have only one (1) eye, you may be passed if the vision level with that eye is 20/40 or better.

label: Failing the screening sends you to a specialist
statement: Vision worse than 20/40 or a serious visual defect fails the screening, and you are advised to consult a vision specialist to see whether your vision can be brought to the 20/40 level.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: If your vision is less than 20/40 or you have a serious visual defect, you will not pass the screening and will be advised to consult a vision specialist to determine if your vision can be brought to the 20/40 level.

label: At least 25 questions, drawn from the handbook
statement: The knowledge examination has at least 25 questions based on the basic knowledge, traffic rules, regulations, signs and markings found in the handbook.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: The knowledge examination has at least 25 questions based on the basic knowledge, traffic rules, regulations, signs, and markings found in the  handbook.

label: 19 out of 25 to pass
statement: You must answer 19 out of the 25 questions correctly to pass the knowledge test.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: You must answer 19 out of the 25 questions correctly to pass the test.

label: The test is timed, and blanks count as wrong
statement: There is a time limit on the test, and any question not answered in the prescribed time is considered incorrect.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: There is a time limit on the test and any questions not answered in the prescribed time will be considered incorrect.

label: An audio version exists for the reading impaired
statement: Audio versions of the knowledge examination are available for the reading impaired and are administered with headphones.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Audio versions of the knowledge examination are available for the reading impaired.  The test is administered with headphones.

label: DMV staff cannot read or explain the test
statement: DMV employees are not to read the test to you, re-word information, or give extra help explaining questions that a printed-exam applicant would not receive.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Employees of the DMV are not to read the test to you, re-word the information, or provide additional help explaining questions that would not be supplied to applicants taking the printed knowledge exam.

label: Valid inspection sticker and proof of insurance
statement: The testing vehicle is checked for compliance with registration, inspection and equipment laws, and a valid inspection sticker and proof of insurance are required before it can be used for the road skills test.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: The testing vehicle must first be checked to make sure it complies with registration, vehicle inspection and equipment laws.  A valid inspection sticker and proof of insurance on the vehicle is required before the vehicle can be used for the road skills test.

label: No switching vehicles on the same test date
statement: A minor defect may be corrected so the examination can continue, but you may not continue the examination in another vehicle on the same test date.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: you will not be permitted to continue the examination in another vehicle on the same test date

label: You must locate and demonstrate the safety equipment
statement: You must know the location and function of all safety equipment including the parking/emergency brake, and being unable to both locate and demonstrate any of it is an automatic failure on the road skills test.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: The applicant must know the location and function of all safety equipment, including the parking/emergency brake.  If the applicant is unable to both locate and demonstrate the use of any of the vehicle safety equipment, this will result in an automatic failure on the road skills test.

label: Window tint below 35 percent is illegal equipment
statement: Windows tinted to less than 35 percent light transmission are listed as illegal equipment.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Windows tinted to less than 35 percent light transmission

label: Red or blue flashing lights are for emergency vehicles only
statement: Red and/or blue flashing lights are illegal equipment because only authorized emergency vehicles may carry those warning lights.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Red and/or blue flashing lights (Only authorized emergency vehicles may have these warning lights)

label: The road test comes after the knowledge examination
statement: The road test is not given until you have passed all other parts of the knowledge examination.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: The road test, or driving examination, will not be given until you have passed all other parts of the knowledge examination.

label: Adjust seat and mirror first, then both hands on the wheel
statement: Adjust the seat and rear view mirror before driving, keep both hands on the steering wheel, and do not rest your elbow in the window.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Adjust the vehicle seat and rear view mirror before driving.  Proper seat  adjustment assures better control of the vehicle.

label: Basic control skills exercises
statement: You may be tested on a subset of the basic control skills exercises: left and right side parallel parking, forward and reverse two-point turnabouts, and the three-point turnabout.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.section: How To Prepare For Your Driver's Test
source.sourceQuote: During the test, you may be tested on a subset of the following Basic Control Skills exercises:

label: Every missed or misused signal is an error
statement: Each time you fail to use or improperly use your turn signal during an exercise it counts as an error, and a signal that cancels automatically must be reactivated when needed.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.section: How To Prepare For Your Driver's Test
source.sourceQuote: Each time you fail to use or improperly use your turn signal it will count as an error.

label: Stop where you can see the rear tires ahead
statement: A safe gap when stopping behind another vehicle is to stop where you can see the rear tires of the vehicle ahead of you.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: A safe gap when stopping behind another vehicle is to stop where you can see the rear tires of the vehicle ahead of you.

label: You will be asked to identify traffic signs
statement: During the road test you will be asked to identify a number of traffic signs, which can be located anywhere on the route.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: During the road test you will be asked to identify a number of traffic signs.  They can be located anywhere on the road test.

label: Touching a cone or jumping a curb ends the test
statement: Hitting, tapping or moving a cone, barrel or flag is an automatic failure, as is jumping a curb during any part of the driving test.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Hitting, tapping, or moving a cone, barrel, or flag

label: Not wearing your safety belt disqualifies you
statement: Failing to use your safety belt during the road test disqualifies you.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: If you do not use your safety belt

label: Any use of a wireless device disqualifies you
statement: Using your wireless communications device at any time during the road test disqualifies you.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: If at anytime you use your wireless communications device

label: The examiner taking control ends the test
statement: If the examiner has to take control of the vehicle you are disqualified.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: If the examiner has to take control of the vehicle

label: Forgetting required glasses disqualifies you
statement: Failing to wear your glasses when they are required disqualifies you from the road test.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: If you fail to wear your glasses if required

label: No retest twice within one week
statement: Applicants who fail either the knowledge or road skills test may not be tested twice within a period of one week.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Applicants who fail either the knowledge or road skills test may not be tested twice within a period of one (1) week, in accordance with §17B-2-6, West Virginia State Code.

label: A short DUI awareness course follows the road test
statement: All first-time applicants must complete a short DUI awareness course, given upon passing the road skills test.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: The DMV requires that all first-time applicants for a driver's license or motorcycle-only West Virginia driver's license complete a short DUI awareness course given upon passing the road skills test.

label: Slower traffic keeps right
statement: Slower traffic should drive in the right-hand lane except when passing.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Slower traffic should drive in the right-hand lane, except when passing.

label: Give trucks and buses room to adjust
statement: Trucks and buses entering an interstate may need extra time to adjust to traffic patterns, so give them extra time and space.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Remember that trucks and buses entering the interstate may need extra time to adjust to traffic patterns.

label: Even runs east-west, odd runs north-south
statement: Even-numbered interstates run east to west and odd-numbered interstates run north to south.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Even-numbered interstates run east to west.

label: Three-digit numbers: beltways and spurs
statement: A three-digit interstate number beginning with an even digit is a beltway or bypass around a city, and one beginning with an odd digit is a spur route.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Three-digit numbers with an even first number identify beltways or bypasses around cities.

label: Plan the route and check the vehicle first
statement: Because interstate entrances and exits are sometimes far apart, plan your route in advance and make sure your vehicle is in good working condition.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Since interstate entrances and exits are sometimes far apart, it is important to plan your route in advance.  Make sure your vehicle is in good working condition.

label: The first guide sign comes well in advance
statement: The first guide sign for an interchange is placed well in advance of the turn-off so there is ample time to change lanes and exit smoothly.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: On interstates, the first guide sign for an interchange is placed well in advance of the point where you must turn off.  This permits ample time to change lanes and exit smoothly.

label: An exit ramp may sit next to the entrance ramp
statement: An exit ramp is often next to the entrance ramp and is marked with Do Not Enter and Wrong Way signs, so pay careful attention to the signs as you enter.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Often, an exit ramp will be next to the entrance ramp, marked with “Do Not Enter” and “Wrong Way” signs.

label: Advisory speed signs warn of a sharp ramp curve
statement: Look for advisory speed limit signs on the ramp; they are used where the ramp curves sharply.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Look for any advisory speed limit signs on the ramp.  These are used if the ramp curves sharply.

label: Start the merge sequence halfway along the ramp
statement: About halfway along the entrance ramp you begin the merging steps: check interstate traffic, signal, find a gap and match your speed to it.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: About halfway on the entrance ramp, start taking these steps:

label: Check with quick glances over your shoulder
statement: Check interstate traffic with quick glances over your shoulder and to the side while watching the vehicles ahead of you entering the acceleration lane.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Take quick glances over your shoulder and to the side.

label: Never stop on the ramp or acceleration lane
statement: Do not stop on the entrance ramp or the acceleration lane, and be ready to adjust if a vehicle ahead of you slows or stops without warning.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Do not stop on the ramp or acceleration lane.

label: Stopping past the acceleration lane is a last resort
statement: If no gap is available it may be necessary to drive onto the shoulder beyond the end of the acceleration lane and stop, but because entering from a stop is hazardous this is a last resort.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: it may be necessary to drive onto the shoulder beyond the end of the acceleration lane and stop

label: Interstate traffic has the right-of-way
statement: Traffic already on the interstate has the right-of-way, and you cannot count on other drivers seeing you or moving over to give you room to enter.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: You cannot always count on other drivers seeing you or moving over to give you room to enter.

label: Signal and move over well before the exit
statement: Signal and move into the exit lane well before you have to exit, because changing lanes at the last moment risks missing the exit or causing a crash.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Signal and move into the lane well before you have to exit.  Changing lanes at the last moment risks missing your exit or causing a crash.

label: Slow down in the deceleration lane, not on the interstate
statement: Most exits have a lane for slowing down before the ramp; never slow down on the interstate itself, but wait until you are in the deceleration lane and then brake gently to the posted ramp speed.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Most interstate exits have a special lane for you to slow down in before you reach the exit ramp.  Never slow down on the interstate.

label: Shoulders are for disabled vehicles only
statement: Interstate shoulders are to be used only for disabled vehicles, not for changing drivers, reading a map or other non-emergency purposes.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Shoulders on interstates are to be used only for disabled vehicles.  Do not use the shoulders for changing drivers, reading a map, or other non emergency purposes.

label: Never stop in the exit gore
statement: Do not stop in the exit gore, the triangular area between the through lane and the exit ramp, because a driver who has missed the exit may cross it and strike your vehicle.
