source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Do not stop in an exit gore (the triangular area between the through lane and the exit ramp).

label: Never make a U-turn on an interstate
statement: Never make a U-turn on an interstate; go to the next exit to turn around, and leave the median crossovers to police and emergency vehicles.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: You should never make a U-turn on an interstate.  Go to the next exit to turn around before re-entering the interstate.

label: Do not drive slower than 55 mph
statement: Never drive faster than the legal speed limit, and do not drive slower than 55 mph on an interstate unless weather or road conditions are bad or a lower speed has been posted.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Do not drive slower than 55 mph on an interstate unless the weather or road conditions are bad or a lower speed has been posted.

label: Driving much slower than traffic creates a hazard
statement: Driving much slower than other drivers on an interstate creates a hazard, because other drivers may be forced to change lanes abruptly.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: When you drive on interstates at a speed much slower than other  drivers, you create a hazard.

label: Headlights on in adverse conditions
statement: Headlights must be turned on during adverse conditions, in accordance with §17C-15-2 of the West Virginia State Code.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: In accordance with §17C-15-2 of the West Virginia State Code, headlights must be turned on during adverse conditions.

label: What to do if your vehicle becomes disabled
statement: If your vehicle becomes disabled, move as far off the road as possible, turn on your four-way flashers, and get everyone out of the vehicle and well away from the road.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: If your vehicle  becomes disabled, move as far off the road as possible, turn on your four-way flashers to indicate your vehicle is stopped, and get everyone out of the vehicle and well away from the road.

label: Flare placement: one vehicle length and 300 feet
statement: Put a flare about one vehicle length behind your vehicle and another about 300 feet back, each on the shoulder near the edge of the through lane.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Put a flare about one (1) vehicle length behind your vehicle and another about 300 feet back.

label: Very dense fog: leave the interstate
statement: If fog is very dense it may be better to leave the interstate and use slower roads to reach your destination.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: If the fog is very dense, it may be better to leave the interstate and use the slower roads to reach your destination.

label: Move over early for a closed lane
statement: When a lane is closed, signs are posted well in advance; move over to the open lane as soon as possible instead of waiting until the last minute.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: If a lane is closed, signs will be posted well in advance.  You should move over to the open lane as soon as possible.  Avoid waiting until the last minute to change lanes.

label: The five bad driving habits
statement: Bad driving habits result from laziness, impatience, inattention, arrogance and aggressiveness.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Bad driving habits result from laziness, impatience, inattention,

label: Turn your head, don't just use mirrors
statement: Always turn your head and look behind you for traffic before changing lanes, pulling from the curb or opening your door.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Always turn your head and look behind you

label: Always signal your intention
statement: Always signal before turning, changing lanes, or driving away from the curb.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Always signal your intention before turning, changing

label: A complete stop is required
statement: You must come to a complete stop at a stop sign or red light regardless of traffic, even when making a right turn.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: a complete stop at a stop sign or red light,

label: Driving is a full-time job
statement: The driver's seat is no place for daydreaming, window shopping or distracting conversation.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: of concentration can result in a driver's failure to be observant enough to avoid a crash.

label: Dim within 500 feet when meeting
statement: Dim your headlight beams within 500 feet of an oncoming vehicle.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: dim your headlight beams within 500

label: Dim within 200 feet when following
statement: Dim your headlights within 200 feet of a vehicle you are following.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: dim your headlights within 200 feet of the

label: Overdriving your headlights
statement: Overdriving your headlights means driving too fast to stop safely within the distance clearly lit by them.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: means driving too fast to stop safely within the distance clearly lit by your

label: Oncoming headlight glare
statement: Looking directly into oncoming headlights causes momentary blindness; slow down, keep right and look at the right edge of the road.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Looking directly into oncoming headlights causes momentary blindness.

label: Headlights, not parking lights
statement: Turn on headlights rather than parking lights when it begins to get dark or whenever visibility may be impaired.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: It is the law and a good idea to turn on your headlights, not just your parking

label: The start of a light rain is worst
statement: At the start of a light rain, oil, dirt and water form a slippery film that increases stopping distance.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: a mixture of oil, dirt, and water form a slippery film on the road.

label: Hydroplaning speeds
statement: Partial hydroplaning begins around 35 mph, and at 55 mph tires can ride entirely on top of the water.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: partial hydroplaning occurs on the road at about 35 mph.

label: Preventing hydroplaning
statement: Slow down in rain, keep tires properly inflated, and replace tires when tread wear indicators are visible.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Keep tires properly inflated.

label: Never drive into flood water
statement: Never attempt to drive across a flooded roadway.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Never attempt to drive across a flooded roadway.

label: How little water it takes
statement: As little as six inches of water can float some smaller vehicles, and two feet will carry most away.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: As little as six (6) inches of water can float some smaller vehicles, while two

label: Braking on ice and snow
statement: On ice or packed snow apply the brakes gently and smoothly, releasing at the first hint the wheels are slipping.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: always apply the brakes gently and smoothly.

label: Anti-lock brakes and steering
statement: With anti-lock brakes you keep the ability to steer while braking; without them you cannot steer unless you pump the brakes.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: In a vehicle equipped with anti-lock brakes, you maintain the ability to steer while braking.

label: Driving in fog or smoke
statement: In fog or dense smoke, reduce speed, be prepared for an emergency stop, and use low-beam headlights.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Use your low-beam headlights.

label: WV inspection every two years
statement: West Virginia requires an inspection of all vehicles every two years, and removing the inspection sticker is against the law.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: West Virginia requires an

label: Common defects that cause crashes
statement: Common vehicle defects that cause crashes include faulty tires, brakes, lights, wipers, defrosters, exhaust, horn, mirrors and unusable seat belts.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Common vehicle defects that cause crashes are faulty tires, brakes, lights, windshield wipers, defrosters

label: Rest breaks on long trips
statement: On a long trip take a 10-minute rest break at least every two hours, spent outside the vehicle.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: take a 10-minute rest break at least every two (2) hours.

label: What fatigue does
statement: Being tired dulls your mind and slows your reaction time.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Being tired dulls your mind and slows your reaction time.

label: Emotional state before driving
statement: Gain self control over anger, worry or fear before driving.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: control these emotions and gain self control before driving.

label: The vehicle ahead may stop suddenly
statement: Always assume the vehicle ahead may stop suddenly and without warning, and keep a safe following distance.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: the vehicle ahead of you may stop suddenly and without

label: When another vehicle passes you
statement: Do not treat being passed as a challenge: slow down, keep as close to the right as possible and make it easier for them to pass.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: slow down, and keep as close to the right side of the road as possible, making

label: Speeding to pass is illegal
statement: Exceeding the speed limit when passing is illegal; if you have to speed to pass, you probably do not need to pass.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Exceeding the speed limit when passing is

label: Your duty to the driver behind
statement: You have a responsibility to the driver following you to signal whenever you change your driving pattern.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: have a responsibility to the driver following you to signal whenever you make a change in your driving

label: Everyone must be belted
statement: Everyone in a passenger vehicle must wear a federally approved safety belt.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.section: Safety Belts - It is the Law
source.sourceQuote: Everyone in a passenger vehicle must wear a federally approved

label: The driver is responsible
statement: It is the driver's responsibility to ensure that all passengers are buckled into their safety belts.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.section: Safety Belts - It is the Law
source.sourceQuote: It is the responsibility of the driver to ensure that all passengers are buckled into their

label: The one legal exception
statement: The only legal exception is for persons 18 years or older riding in the back seat; a medical exception may also be issued with proof.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.section: Safety Belts - It is the Law
source.sourceQuote: The only legal exception is for persons 18 years or older who are riding in the back

label: How much belts reduce harm
statement: Wearing safety belts reduces the chances of injury or death from collisions by 45 to 50 percent.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.section: Safety Belts - It is the Law
source.sourceQuote: collisions by 45 to 50 percent.

label: How to wear a belt correctly
statement: The lap belt should fit snugly over the lower part of the hips, and the shoulder belt should be worn with it.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.section: Safety Belts - It is the Law
source.sourceQuote: and comfortably over the lower part of the hips.

label: Child safety seats under 8
statement: A driver transporting a child under the age of 8 must secure the child in a child passenger safety device meeting federal safety standards.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: safety device system meeting applicable federal motor vehicle safety standards

label: The height exception
statement: A child under 8 who is at least 4 feet 9 inches tall may use a safety belt instead of a child safety seat.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: a safety belt shall be sufficient to meet the

label: Arm signals for turning and stopping
statement: Arm pointing down means slow or stop, arm pointing up means right turn, and arm straight out means left turn.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Laws and Rules of the Road
source.sourceQuote: ARM POINTING DOWN ARM POINTING UP ARM STRAIGHT OUT

label: Octagon means stop
statement: An eight-sided sign is always a stop sign: you must stop completely and give the right-of-way to pedestrians and all cross traffic before moving again.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: These eight-sided signs are reserved for stop signs.  These signs mean you must stop completely. Give the right-of-way to pedestrians and to all cross traffi  c before moving again.

label: Where to stop at a stop sign
statement: Stop behind the marked or unmarked crosswalk, or before entering the intersection if there are no markings, at a place where you can see traffic from all directions.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: At a stop sign, you must stop behind any marked or unmarked crosswalk (joining sidewalks on opposite sides of the street).  If there are no pavement markings or cross walks, you must stop before entering an intersection.

label: Upside-down triangle means yield
statement: A downward-pointing triangle is a yield sign, which requires you to yield the right-of-way to cross traffic or to merging traffic.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.section: Single Message Shaped Signs - Triangle (upside down)
source.sourceQuote: This shape requires that you yield the right-of-way to cross traffi  c or to merging traffi  c.

label: Pennant marks a no-passing zone
statement: A pennant-shaped sign marks the beginning of a no-passing zone.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: This sign marks the beginning of a no-passing zone.

label: Pentagon means school zone
statement: A five-sided sign warns of a school zone ahead or marks a school crossing, where the maximum speed limit is 15 m.p.h. when children are present or when specified.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: The maximum speed limit in a school zone is 15 m.p.h. when children are present or when specifi ed.

label: Upright triangle marks a slow-moving vehicle
statement: A right-side-up triangle with a reflective red border and fluorescent orange centre identifies a slow moving vehicle or a vehicle that has made an emergency stop.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.section: Single Message Shaped Signs - Triangle (right side up)
source.sourceQuote: A right side up triangular sign with a refl ective red border and fl uorescent orange center identifi es a slow moving vehicle or a vehicle which has made an emergency stop.

label: Regulatory sign colours
statement: Most regulatory signs are white with black letters, and the sign is red with white letters when the message is very important.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Most signs are white with black letters. When the message is very important, the sign is red with white letters.

label: A red slash always means NO
statement: A red outline with a diagonal bar through it always means NO — whatever is pictured inside is prohibited.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: A red outline with a diagonal bar through it always means “NO.”

label: Speed limit and advisory speed signs
statement: A speed limit sign shows the fastest speed allowed under optimal weather and road conditions, while black-on-yellow advisory signs show a recommended safe speed.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: These signs show the fastest speed you may drive under

label: Yellow diamond warns of danger ahead
statement: Diamond-shaped warning signs are yellow with black letters, usually appear without explanatory words, and warn of possible danger ahead.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: These  diamond-shaped signs will usually appear without  explanatory words beneath them.  These signs are yellow with black letters.  They warn of possible danger ahead and may have symbols or written warnings.

label: Yellow-green pedestrian and school warnings
statement: Pedestrian and school warning signs may be yellow-green with black letters rather than yellow.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Pedestrian and school warning signs may be yellow-green with black letters.

label: Orange is the work-zone colour
statement: Orange is the basic colour for work-zone traffic control devices, which warn of unusual or potentially dangerous conditions in or near work areas.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.section: Construction and Maintenance Signs and Devices
source.sourceQuote: The most commonly used traffi  c control devices are signs, barricades, drums, cones, tubes, fl ashing arrow panels, and fl aggers.  Orange is the basic color for these devices.

label: Guide sign colours
statement: Most guide signs are white on green, motorist services signs are white on blue, and park and recreation signs are white on brown.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Most guide signs are white on green. Motorist services signs are white on blue.   Signs for parks and public recreation areas are white on brown.

label: Railroad crossing signs
statement: Railroad crossing signs may be round or diamond-shaped yellow signs with black symbols, or black letters on white bars in the shape of an X called a crossbuck.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Railroad crossing signs can be round or diamond shaped, yellow with black symbols, or  black letters on white bars in the shape of an X called a crossbuck.

label: You must yield to all trains
statement: You must yield to all trains, and failing to stop when the lights are flashing or a barrier is down will result in a citation.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: You must yield to all trains.  Failure to stop when lights are fl ashing, or a barrier is down, will result in a citation.

label: Never enter a crossing you cannot clear
statement: Do not enter a railroad crossing until the vehicle ahead has moved far enough that you can clear the tracks, or you may be trapped on them.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: you should not enter a railroad crossing until the vehicle ahead has moved far enough ahead that you can clear the tracks.  Otherwise, you may be trapped on the tracks and hit by another vehicle or by a train.

label: Circular green
statement: On a circular green you may enter the intersection and go straight, right or left unless signs or markings prohibit the movement, and a left turn must yield to oncoming vehicles.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Drivers facing this signal may enter the intersection and go straight through, turn right, or left, unless, other traffi  c control devices (signs or pavement markings) prohibit certain movements.

label: Green arrow
statement: A green arrow allows you to make the movement the arrow shows, and in a left-turn signal it usually means opposing traffic is stopped.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: A green arrow may be shown alone or with other indications.  Drivers facing the signal may enter the intersection to make the movement shown by the arrow.

label: Steady yellow
statement: A steady yellow means the green is ending and will change to red, and you should only drive through it if your vehicle is already within the intersection.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: This means that the green light is ending and will change to red.  You should only drive through a yellow light if the vehicle clearance is within the intersection.

label: Steady red
statement: Traffic facing a steady circular red must stop and remain stopped until another indication allows it to proceed, unless a green arrow permits the movement.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Traffi  c facing a steady circular red signal must stop unless making a movement permitted by a green arrow.  The driver must remain stopped until allowed to proceed by another indication.

label: Turning on red
statement: After a complete stop and yielding to all other traffic and pedestrians, you may turn right on red at two-way streets, or left on red from a one-way street onto another one-way street, unless signs prohibit it.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: A driver may turn right on red at the intersection of two-way streets, or may turn left on red from a one-way street to another one-way street.  These turns may be made after yielding to all other traffi  c and pedestrians, and if no signs are posted to prohibit them.

label: Flashing red and flashing yellow
statement: A circular flashing red is the same as a stop sign, while a circular flashing yellow lets you proceed through the intersection with caution.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: A circular fl ashing red is the same as a stop sign; that is, drivers must come to

label: WALK and DON'T WALK signals
statement: Crosswalk signals are traffic signals for pedestrians and must be obeyed: the hand or DON'T WALK means do not cross, and the walking man or WALK means it is safe to cross inside the lines.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Crosswalk signals are traffi  c signals for pedestrians.  If these signals are in place, pedestrians are to obey them.

label: Blind pedestrians always have the right-of-way
statement: A blind person on foot using a guide dog or service animal, or carrying a white cane or walking stick, has the right-of-way whether or not they are in a crosswalk.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: A blind person who is on foot and using a guide dog or other service animal, or is carrying a white cane or walking stick, has the right-of-way on a highway, street, or road regardless of whether they are in a crosswalk or not.

label: White lines versus yellow lines
statement: White lines separate lanes of traffic moving in the same direction, and yellow lines separate traffic moving in opposite directions.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: WHITE lines separate traffic lanes moving in the SAME direction.

label: Broken yellow line
statement: A broken yellow line on your side of the road means you may pass when it is safe to do so.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Broken yellow lines separate traffic moving in opposite directions.  If this marking is on your side of the road, you may pass when it is safe.

label: Solid yellow line
statement: If a solid yellow line is on your side of the road, you must not pass.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: If a solid yellow line is on your side of the road, you MUST NOT PASS.

label: Broken and solid white lines
statement: Broken white lines separate same-direction lanes and must not be straddled except when changing lanes, while solid white lines mark the pavement edge and forbid lane changes where they separate same-direction lanes.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: On roadways which have more than one (1) lane moving in one direction, traffic lanes are separated by broken white lines.

label: Diamond lanes
statement: White diamond shapes painted in a lane mean it is designated for car pools, bicycles or buses.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: White diamond shapes painted in the roadway to inform drivers the lane is designated for car pools, bicycles, or buses.

label: Centre left-turn lane
statement: A centre left-turn lane is reserved for left turns from either direction and must never be used as a through or passing lane.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Center Left-Turn Lanes - These lanes are reserved for left turns from either direction and are not to be used as through or passing lanes.

label: Stop lines and crosswalk lines
statement: A wide white stop line marks where you must stop, and where there is no stop line or crosswalk you must stop before entering the intersection.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Stop Lines - Wide white lines, painted across traffic lanes, mark where you must stop your vehicle at intersections.

label: Reasonable and prudent for conditions
statement: West Virginia law prohibits driving at a speed greater than is reasonable and prudent for existing conditions, even when the posted limit is higher.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Laws and Rules of the Road
source.sourceQuote: West Virginia law prohibits driving at a speed that is greater than reasonable and prudent for existing conditions.

label: Designated speed limits
statement: Unless otherwise posted, the designated limits are 70 mph on interstates, 55 mph on open county highways, 25 mph in business or residential areas, and 15 mph in a school zone while children are present.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Laws and Rules of the Road
source.sourceQuote: Interstate - Maximum Speed 70mph unless otherwise posted

label: What counts as a school zone
statement: A school zone is all school property plus any abutting street or highway, extending 125 feet along that street or highway from the school grounds.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Laws and Rules of the Road
source.sourceQuote: A school zone is all school property, including school grounds, and/or any street or highway abutting the school grounds and extending 125 feet along the street or highway from the school grounds.

label: Signal at least 100 feet ahead
statement: Signal at least 100 feet before you turn, and signal every time you change lanes, turn, enter or leave an interstate, or pull away from or over to the curb.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Laws and Rules of the Road
source.sourceQuote: Get into the habit of signaling every time you make a change.  Signal at least 100 feet before you plan to turn.

label: Slow before the turn, finish in the proper lane
statement: Slow down before making a turn rather than braking while turning, and always finish the turn in the proper lane.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Laws and Rules of the Road
source.sourceQuote: Slow down before making turns.  Do not brake while turning.

label: Keep the wheels straight waiting to turn left
statement: While waiting to turn left, do not turn your wheels to the left, because a bump from behind could push your vehicle into oncoming traffic.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Laws and Rules of the Road
source.sourceQuote: When waiting to turn left, do not turn the wheels to the left.  Otherwise, a bump from behind could push your vehicle into oncoming traffi  c.

label: Where turning around is illegal
statement: It is against the law to turn your vehicle around near a curve or near the crest of a hill where you cannot be seen by a vehicle approaching within 500 feet in either direction, or where signs prohibit turning.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Laws and Rules of the Road
source.sourceQuote: it is against the law to turn your vehicle around near a curve, near the crest of a hill where you cannot be seen by another vehicle approaching within 500 feet in either direction, or where signs  prohibit turning.

label: Backing up safely
statement: Before backing, check completely around the vehicle, keep looking to the rear while backing instead of depending on the mirror, and never back across traffic lanes or through an intersection.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Laws and Rules of the Road
source.sourceQuote: Before backing, check completely around your vehicle for people and/or other obstacles.  You should look to the front, sides and rear and continue to look to the rear while backing. Do not depend on your mirror.

label: Direction of parking and securing the vehicle
statement: Park facing the same direction as traffic moves on that side of the street, and whenever you leave the vehicle turn off the engine and set the parking brake.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Laws and Rules of the Road
source.sourceQuote: Vehicles must always be parked in the same direction as the movement of traffi  c on that side of the street.

label: Prohibited parking distances
statement: Parking is prohibited within 15 feet of a fire hydrant, 20 feet of a crosswalk at an intersection, 30 feet of a stop sign or traffic signal, and 50 feet of the nearest rail of a railroad crossing.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Laws and Rules of the Road
source.section: Prohibited Parking (§17C-13-3, W. Va. State Code)
source.sourceQuote: Within 15 feet of a fi re hydrant

label: Parking on a grade
statement: When you park or stop on a grade, turn the front wheels to the curb side of the highway so the vehicle will not roll, and set the emergency or parking brake.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Laws and Rules of the Road
source.sourceQuote: If you park or stop on a grade, turn the front wheels to the curb side of the highway so the vehicle will not roll.  Be sure to set the emergency or parking brake.

label: Parallel parking distance
statement: A parallel parked vehicle must have its wheels within 18 inches of the curb and must face the direction of traffic.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Laws and Rules of the Road
source.section: Parallel Parking (§17C-13-4, W. Va. State Code)
source.sourceQuote: When parallel parking on the left side of the road, wheels should be within 18 inches of the left curb.  Park in the direction of the traffic.

label: The three-to-four second rule
statement: Pick a fixed object ahead, and if you reach it before finishing the count of one thousand three after the vehicle ahead passes it, you are following too closely.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Laws and Rules of the Road
source.sourceQuote: To use the three-to-four second rule, choose a fixed object on the road ahead (such as a signpost, tree, overpass, or bridge abutment).  When the vehicle ahead passes that object, begin to count “one thousand one, one thousand two, one thousand three.”

label: More seconds in bad conditions
statement: Following distance should be at least four seconds when it is dark or raining, and at least six seconds on ice or snow.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Laws and Rules of the Road
source.sourceQuote: If it is dark or raining, the distance should be at least four seconds.

label: How to change lanes
statement: Check the mirrors, make a head check over your shoulder for the blind spot, watch for other drivers moving into the same lane, then signal and change lanes.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Laws and Rules of the Road
source.sourceQuote: Check over your left or right shoulder (head check) to make sure no one is in your blind spot.

label: Finishing a pass
statement: Signal and return to the proper lane once you can see the front of the passed vehicle — both headlights — in your rear view mirror, and do not pass on the right unless a lane is designated for passing.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Laws and Rules of the Road
source.sourceQuote: Signal and return to the proper lane when you see the front of the vehicle (both headlights) you have passed in your rear view mirror. Passing on the right is not permissible unless there is a lane designated for passing.

label: Where passing is prohibited
statement: Passing is prohibited on a curve or hill where you cannot see oncoming traffic, within 100 feet of an intersection, bridge, viaduct, tunnel, underpass or railroad crossing, and when a solid yellow line is in your lane.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Laws and Rules of the Road
source.section: Passing is PROHIBITED in the following places
source.sourceQuote: On a curve or hill or at any place where you cannot see oncoming traffic.

label: Right-of-way is given, not taken
statement: Right-of-way is something to be given rather than taken, so yield even when the rules are on your side if another driver does not follow them.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Laws and Rules of the Road
source.sourceQuote: Remember, in every situation, right-of-way is something to be given, not taken.

label: Entering a road from a driveway or alley
statement: When entering a public street or highway from an alley, private road or driveway, you must yield to traffic already on the roadway.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Laws and Rules of the Road
source.sourceQuote: When entering a public street or highway from an alley, private road, or driveway, you must yield to traffic already on the roadway.

label: Arriving at the same time
statement: At uncontrolled intersections and four-way stops, if you reach the intersection at the same time as another vehicle you yield to the driver on the right.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Laws and Rules of the Road
source.sourceQuote: Uncontrolled intersections and four-way stop intersections - If you reach the intersection at the same time as another vehicle, yield to the driver on the right.

label: Left turns yield to oncoming traffic
statement: When making a left turn you must yield the right-of-way to oncoming traffic.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Laws and Rules of the Road
source.sourceQuote: When making a left turn, you must yield the right-of-way to oncoming traffic.

label: Emergency vehicles
statement: Yield to any emergency vehicle sounding a siren and flashing warning lights by pulling over to the right edge of the road, clear of the intersection, and stopping until it has passed.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Laws and Rules of the Road
source.sourceQuote: You must yield to any emergency vehicle (ambulance, fire, or police vehicle) that is sounding a siren and flashing warning lights. Pull over to the right edge of the road, clear of the intersection, and stop until the emergency vehicle has passed.

label: Police officers and funeral processions
statement: A police officer's directions overrule any sign, signal or road marking, and yielding to a funeral procession is a courtesy rather than a legal requirement.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Laws and Rules of the Road
source.sourceQuote: Directions of a police officer overrule the message of any sign, signal, or road marking.

label: When pedestrians have the right of way
statement: Pedestrians have the right of way in a crosswalk, when crossing a sidewalk that crosses an alley entrance or driveway, and when blind and using a cane or guide dog.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Laws and Rules of the Road
source.sourceQuote: They are crossing a sidewalk that crosses an alley entrance or driveway.

label: What pedestrians must do
statement: Pedestrians must use crosswalks at intersections, walk on the left side facing oncoming traffic where there is no sidewalk, and must not walk on interstate highways.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Laws and Rules of the Road
source.section: Sharing the Road with Pedestrians - Pedestrians must
source.sourceQuote: When walking along a road where there is no sidewalk, walk on the left side facing oncoming traffic. Walk on the shoulder of the road, if possible.

label: Both directions must stop
statement: On all highways, streets, parking lots, private roads and driveways, traffic in both directions must stop before reaching a school bus with its red lights flashing that is receiving or discharging students.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Laws and Rules of the Road
source.sourceQuote: On all highways, streets, parking lots, private roads or driveways, traffic in both directions must stop before reaching a school bus that has its red

label: When you may move again
statement: You may not proceed until the bus resumes motion, the school bus driver signals you to proceed, or the visual signals are no longer operating.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Laws and Rules of the Road
source.sourceQuote: proceed until the bus resumes motion, or signaled by the school bus driver to proceed or the visual signals are no longer actuated.

label: The interstate exception
statement: Only on interstate highways does traffic coming toward a school bus stopped on the other side of the median not have to stop.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Laws and Rules of the Road
source.sourceQuote: Only on Interstate Highways does traffic coming toward a school bus stopped on the other side of the median not have to stop.

label: Penalty for passing a stopped school bus
statement: A first offence of passing a stopped school bus carries a minimum 60-day driver's license suspension and a minimum $500 fine or confinement in jail for not more than six months.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Laws and Rules of the Road
source.sourceQuote: The penalty for passing a stopped school bus is a minimum of 60 days driver’s license suspension and a minimum fine of $500 or confinement in jail for not more than six (6) months for the first offense.

label: Dimming distances
statement: Dim your headlights within 500 feet of an approaching vehicle and within 200 feet of the vehicle in front of you.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Laws and Rules of the Road
source.sourceQuote: Dim your headlights within 500 feet of an approaching vehicle.

label: When headlights must be on
statement: Turn on your headlights from sunset to sunrise, during fog, smoke or rain, and any other time people and vehicles cannot be seen clearly at 500 feet.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Laws and Rules of the Road
source.sourceQuote: Turn on your headlights from sunset to sunrise, during fog, smoke, rain, or at any other time when persons and vehicles cannot be seen clearly at a distance of 500 feet.

label: Dealing with a tailgater
statement: If a vehicle follows too closely, tap your brakes gently to flash the brake lights, slow down to encourage it to pass, and if that fails pull over and let it by.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Laws and Rules of the Road
source.sourceQuote: Tap your brakes gently to flash the brake lights and warn the tailgater.

label: A motorcycle is entitled to the whole lane
statement: Motorcyclists are entitled to and need the entire lane, so expect them to move around in it and keep a minimum three-to-four second following distance.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Laws and Rules of the Road
source.sourceQuote: Motorcyclists are entitled to and will need the entire lane to maneuver around possible hazards and traffic situations.  It is wise to keep a safe minimum three -to-four second following distance.

label: Following and passing a motorcycle
statement: Stay farther back than you would behind a car because a motorcycle can stop much faster, and when passing go all the way into the other lane and wait until well down the road before returning.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Laws and Rules of the Road
source.sourceQuote: Stay farther back than if you were behind a vehicle.  The motorcycle can usually slow or stop much faster than you can.  When passing, go all the way into the other lane.

label: Trucks need far more room to stop
statement: A fully loaded tractor-trailer travelling 55 mph needs three times the distance a car needs to stop.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Laws and Rules of the Road
source.section: Sharing the Road with Heavy Trucks
source.sourceQuote: A fully loaded tractor-trailer, traveling 55 mph, needs three (3) times the distance a vehicle needs to stop.

label: The No-Zone
statement: A truck's blind spots, called the No-Zone, are dangerous because the driver cannot see you there, and if you cannot see the driver's reflection in the side mirror you are in one.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Laws and Rules of the Road
source.sourceQuote: The easiest way to avoid lingering in the “No-Zone” is to look for the truck driver’s reflection in the side mirror. If you cannot see the driver’s reflection, you are in the truck driver’s blind spot.

label: Merging back in front of a truck
statement: After passing a truck, allow two seconds before merging back in dry conditions, and four to six seconds of space in wet conditions.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Laws and Rules of the Road
source.sourceQuote: In dry conditions use the two-second rule. After passing give two (2) seconds before merging to the right.

label: Passing a bicyclist
statement: When passing a bicyclist, slow down, make sure they are aware of you and leave plenty of room, and if there is no room while traffic is approaching, wait.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Laws and Rules of the Road
source.sourceQuote: When passing a bicyclist, slow down, make sure they are aware of you, and leave plenty of room between him or her and your vehicle.  If there is no room to pass and traffic is approaching, wait until traffic has gone by before passing.

label: Bicyclists follow the same rules
statement: Bicyclists must obey the same rules of the road as other drivers, ride in the same direction as traffic, and yield the right-of-way to pedestrians.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Laws and Rules of the Road
source.sourceQuote: Obey the same rules of the road as drivers of other vehicles.

label: Required bicycle equipment
statement: A bicycle needs a red rear reflector, brakes able to stop one wheel on dry level pavement, a bell audible at 100 feet, and after dark a white headlight visible at 500 feet.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Laws and Rules of the Road
source.sourceQuote: Bell or other device capable of giving a signal audible for a distance of at least 100 feet

label: Horses and animal riders
statement: Animal riders may use most public highways but not interstates, have the same rights and duties as drivers, and you must never sound your horn near a horse.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Laws and Rules of the Road
source.section: Sharing the Road with Animal Riders
source.sourceQuote: Animal riders may use most public highways, but they may not use interstate highways.  Persons riding animals have the same rights as  motor vehicle users and are subject to the same rules.

label: Public buses and children at play
statement: Traffic does not have to stop for a public bus but must watch for passengers crossing, and drivers must be extra careful wherever children are likely to be.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Laws and Rules of the Road
source.section: Sharing the Road with Public Buses
source.sourceQuote: While traffic does not have to stop for a public bus, please watch for passengers crossing the street as they are getting on and off the bus.

label: Fleeing from an officer: 8 points
statement: Fleeing from an officer carries 8 points, the highest single value on the West Virginia point scale.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote:
Fleeing from an Officer 8
Speeding in a School Zone 6

label: The 6-point offenses
statement: Speeding in a school zone, reckless driving, hit and run, and speeding 20 mph or more over the limit each carry 6 points.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote:
Speeding in a School Zone 6
Reckless Driving 6
Hit & Run (Leaving the Scene or Failure to Reveal ID) 6
Speeding 20mph or More Over the Speed Limit 6

label: Speeding points rise in bands
statement: Speeding is scored in bands: 3 points for 11-14 mph over, 5 points for 15-19 mph over, and 6 points for 20 mph or more over the limit.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote:
Speeding 20mph or More Over the Speed Limit 6
Speeding 15mph to 19mph Over the Speed Limit 5
Speeding 11mph to 14mph Over the Speed Limit 3

label: Three wireless violations: 3 points
statement: Three or more wireless communication device violations, in any combination of talking and/or texting, carry 3 points.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote:
3 or More Wireless Communication Device
Violations (Any Combination of Talking and/or  Texting) 3

label: The common 3-point violations
statement: A passing violation, failure to yield, failure to obey a traffic light and failure to obey a stop sign each carry 3 points.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote:
Passing Violation 3
Failure to Yield Violation 3
Failure to Obey Traffic Light 3
Failure to Obey Stop Sign 3

label: The common 2-point violations
statement: Following too closely, more than 3 passengers in the front seat, improper turning, improper backing and improper or no signal each carry 2 points.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote:
Following Too Closely 2
More than 3 Passengers in the Front Seat 2
Improper Turning 2
Improper Backing 2
Improper Signal or No Signal 2

label: Unlisted moving violations: 2 points
statement: All other moving violations not named on the point scale carry 2 points.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: All Other Moving Violations Not Listed Above 2

label: Driving the wrong way on a one way street: 3 points
statement: Driving the wrong way on a one way street carries 3 points.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Driving the Wrong Way on a One Way Street 3

label: Curve or sharp turn ahead
statement: This diamond warns of a curve or sharp turn that is too sharp to take at the regular highway speed; an advisory speed sign may be attached.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote:
Curve or sharp turn in the road ahead  - The curve is too
sharp to take at the regular highway speed.  An advisory speed
sign may be attached.

label: Crossroads or side roads ahead
statement: This diamond warns of crossroads or side roads ahead, so watch for other vehicles entering or leaving the highway.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote:
Crossroads or side roads ahead -
Watch for other vehicles entering or
leaving the highway.

label: A lane is ending
statement: This diamond warns that a lane will be ending, and the symbol is reversed depending on whether it is the right or the left lane.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote:
To  warn  you  that  a  lane  will
be  ending; in this case, the
right lane.  The symbol would
be  reversed  if  the  left  lane  is
ending.

label: An added lane
statement: This diamond advises you that a lane is being added to the road ahead.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote:
This sign is to advise you of an
added lane.

label: Merging traffic
statement: This diamond warns that traffic may be moving into your lane, so be ready to change your speed or your lane to avoid a crash.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote:
may  be  moving  into
your lane. Be ready to change
your  speed  or  your  lane  to
avoid a crash.

label: Two-way road
statement: This diamond is used to indicate that you are on a two-way road, where traffic can come toward you.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote:
Used  to  indicate  that  you  are
on a two-way road.

label: Hill ahead
statement: This diamond warns of hills where special care must be taken, and you should slow down before you start downhill.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote:
Warns you of hills where special
care must be taken.  Slow down
before you start downhill.

label: Low clearance
statement: This diamond warns that a bridge or underpass ahead has low clearance, and the height is shown on the sign.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote:
Ahead a bridge or underpass
has low clearance. The  height
is shown on the sign.

label: Slippery when wet
statement: This diamond warns that the section of highway is more slippery than other roads when wet, so reduce your speed.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote:
This section of highway is more
slippery than other roads when
wet. Reduce your speed.

label: Pedestrian crossing ahead
statement: This diamond warns that a crosswalk or pedestrian path crosses the road; watch out for and yield to people walking across.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote:
This sign warns you that there
is  a  crosswalk  or  pedestrian
path crossing the road. Watch
out  for,  and  yield  to  people
walking across the road.

label: No U-Turn
statement: A No U-Turn sign means do not turn around in the middle of a street or an intersection.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote:
No U-Turn Sign -
This sign means do
not  turn  around  in
the middle of a street
or an intersection.

label: No Right Turn and No Left Turn
statement: These signs indicate which direction you cannot turn at an intersection, and are used where you meet a one way street or where a turn would be unsafe.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote:
sign indicates which direction you cannot
turn at an intersection.  These signs are
used when meeting a one way street or
in situations where it is unsafe to turn.

label: Wrong Way and Do Not Enter
statement: Wrong Way and Do Not Enter signs warn that traffic in that direction is prohibited, and entering such a lane will likely put you into another vehicle.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote:
Wrong Way or Do Not Enter - These signs
warn  you  that  traffic  in  that  direction  is
prohibited.

label: One Way Street
statement: A One Way Street sign tells you when a cross street carries traffic running in one direction only.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote:
One  Way  Street -  This  sign  is
used to tell you when a cross
street

label: One-way blocks usually alternate
statement: Where there are one-way streets, usually every consecutive block runs in the opposite direction.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote:
Usually every
consecutive block runs in the
opposite direction when there are
one-way streets.

label: Dual Turn Lane
statement: A Dual Turn Lane sign is posted over a highway lane used only for making left turns from either direction.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote:
Dual  Turn Lane - This  sign  is
posted over a highway lane that
is used only for making left turns
from either direction.

label: Never pass in a turning lane
statement: Traffic from either direction will be using a dual turn lane, and you must never use a turning lane to overtake and pass other vehicles.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote:
either direction will be using this
lane. Never use a turning lane to
overtake and pass other vehicles.

label: Lane Directions signs
statement: Lane Directions signs are posted at openings in the dividers of a divided highway to remind you which side of the divider you belong on.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote:
Lane Directions - These signs are
posted between highway lanes that are
divided and placed at openings in the
dividers where streets intersect with the
highway.  They are to remind you which
side of the divider you belong on.

label: Why lane use signals exist
statement: Lane use control signals are special signals used when the direction of a street or a certain lane changes during the day.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote:
when the direction of a street or certain lane changes during
the day.

label: Red X: lane closed
statement: A red X means the lane is closed or being used by opposing traffic, and you must not use that lane.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote:
Red X: The lane is
closed or being used
by opposing traffic.
Do not use this lane.

label: Yellow X: get out of the lane
statement: A yellow X means the lane is about to be closed or about to reverse direction, so move out of it as soon as you can.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote:
Yellow X: The  lane is
about to  be closed or
its  direction is  about
to reverse.  Move  out
of it as  soon as  you
can.

label: Green downward arrow: lane open
statement: A green downward arrow means traffic may use the lane under the arrow.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote:
use the lane under
the arrow.

label: Crosswalks mark pedestrian-heavy places
statement: Crosswalks at intersections and in school zones are indicators of a place with heavy pedestrian activity, where extra alertness reduces the risk of crashes.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)

Be aware of crosswalks at intersections and in school zones. These are
indicators

statement: The duty to pull over applies to an emergency vehicle that is sounding a siren AND flashing warning lights — both conditions are in the rule.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)

label: Exactly how to yield
statement: Pull over to the right edge of the road, clear of the intersection, and stop until it has passed — keeping your foot on the brake so the emergency driver sees you are stopped.

statement: Authorized emergency vehicles may exceed posted speed limits only when on emergency duty with their warning devices in use.

statement: Only authorized emergency vehicles may have red and/or blue flashing warning lights.

source.sourceQuote: Red and/or blue flashing lights (Only authorized emergency vehicles may have these warning lights)

label: Blind pedestrian right-of-way
statement: A blind person on foot using a guide dog or service animal, or carrying a white cane or walking stick, has the right-of-way regardless of whether they are in a crosswalk.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)

label: What identifies a blind pedestrian
statement: A white or metal cane, with or without a red tip, or a guide dog, identifies a blind pedestrian who has the right of way.

statement: Do not drive slower than 55 mph on an interstate unless weather or road conditions are bad or a lower speed has been posted.

statement: If you must drive slower than the designated speed, pull off at the first safe turnout to let faster traffic pass.
